senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; דָּלָה)bucket, also used as cover of the well.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 51b:15">B. Kam. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>משימסור לו דָּלְיוֹ</he> from the moment he delivers his bucket (Rashi: cover) to him; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:4:3">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᵇ</cite> top; Y. B. Bath. III, beg. 13ᵈ <he>דָּלְייוֹ</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 4:16">Tosef. Ber. IV, 16</cite> <he>ד׳ של צונן</he> a bucket of cold water; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דֳּלָיִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:6">Gen. R. s. 45</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00965"><he>בַּנְרִיּוֹת</he></cite>. [Y. B. Bath. l. c. (perhaps) <he>דָּלְיָיו</he>].
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:7">Yeb. XVI, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 8:5">Eduy. VIII, 5</cite> (Ms. M. <he>מדלי</he>).
